newsitem.title: POLAND: FINNISH FAZER TO INVEST PLN 20 MLN IN POLISH FIRM.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH FAZER TO INVEST PLN 20 MLN IN POLISH FIRM.

text.p: Finland's Fazer Group will invest 20 million zlotys this year to build two production lines in its Polish subsidiary and boost annual confectionary production to 28,000 tonnes, the head of Fazer Group said.
Felix Bjorklund told a news conference on Thursday the Fazer Polska Sp.z.o., in the north town of Gdansk, produced 12,600 tonnes of confectionary products in 1995 and 1996.
"This year we will invest 20 million in Poland to open two production lines. This will allow us to increase production to 28,000 tonnes annully," Bjorklund said.
Fazer Polska now has about five percent of the Polish confectionary market.
"Fazer Polska's main goal is to increase its market share in Poland and its exports to neighbouring countries. We want to be the biggest in the Baltic area," Bjorklund said.
